page_title: AUG 2-0 LEV | Augsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Now Augsburg have a corner.
90+3' Tempers flare after Samuel Essende (Augsburg) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Anton Kade walks off the pitch and Samuel Essende (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
89' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
88' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and Sven Jablonski immediately signals a free kick.
81' Malik Tillman will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen).
78' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) has received a yellow card for his foul.
77' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.

75' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
73' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Augsburg.
73' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Mert Komur (Augsburg) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
71' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexis Claude-Maurice walks off the pitch to be replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
69' The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
69' Anton Kade (Augsburg) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom right corner is thwarted by Mark Flekken.
65' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
64' 34:66 – the ratio of ball possession.
61' Here's the change. Jonas Hofmann leaves the pitch and Eliesse Ben Seghir (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
61' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Ibrahim Maza will be replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
60' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
60' Sven Jablonski couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) and blew his whistle.
58' Rough tackle by Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' We are about to witness a substitution. Mert Komur (Augsburg) is replacing Fabian Rieder.
57' Manuel Baum has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) replacing Dimitrios Giannoulis.

56' Anton Kade (Augsburg) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken was alert and the score remained the same.
54' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the left post.
52' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
49' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the Augsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
46' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Martin Terrier is replaced by Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on the pitch for Loic Bade.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

45+3' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
45+2' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

45+2' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

44' He should have scored! Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Finn Dahmen makes an easy save.
43' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the right post and ricochets away!
43' The referee points to the corner flag and Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner.
43' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
36' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' An attempted cross from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
34' The ratio of the ball possession is 35:65.
32' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
30' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
28' 2 - 0 Goal! Dimitrios Giannoulis swings the ball deep into the box and finds Anton Kade (Augsburg) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
27' What an opportunity! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) smashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but the ball only crashed against the crossbar!
24' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Sven Jablonski blows the whistle, Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul.
22' The linesman raises his flag. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
19' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
18' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
17' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Anton Kade (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
16' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
15' A big rebound finds it way to Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.
13' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
12' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
12' Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
11' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the top of the net, Finn Dahmen makes a decent save to stop the effort.
11' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
10' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
9' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Fabian Rieder (Augsburg).

6' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) latches on to a precise through ball from Keven Schlotterbeck before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the back of the net from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
5' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
3' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

2' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gathers a rebound, beats his marker and goes for goal from distance, but one of his own teammates inadvertently blocks the effort. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' PENALTY APPEAL after Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
